title: An Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Weather-Driven National Crop-Yield Forecasting: A Case Study of Brazilian Soybean
abstract: arXiv:2609.38447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable, timely crop-yield forecasts are essential for market stability and risk management, yet many approaches rely on costly or hard-to-scale inputs. We present a frugal, transferable, and architecture-agnostic deep learning framework that uses routine weather as the only time-varying input plus two lightweight static context inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label) to capture long-run change and regional heterogeneity, while supporting multiple sequence encoders under identical data requirements. Using a 20-season Brazilian soybean case study (2001/02-2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, we benchmark MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, a Transformer encoder and the Mamba state-space model against linear ridge regression and a five-year moving-average "farmer" baseline. translated_title: 一种用于天气驱动的国家级作物产量预测的输入节俭型深度学习框架：以巴西大豆为例
translated_abstract: 可靠且及时的作物产量预测对市场稳定和风险管理至关重要，然而许多方法依赖于昂贵或难以规模化获取的输入。我们提出了一种节俭、可迁移且架构无关的深度学习框架，该框架仅使用常规天气数据作为唯一的时变输入，加上两个轻量级的静态上下文输入（作物年份和农业环境标签）来捕捉长期变化和区域异质性，同时在相同的数据要求下支持多种序列编码器。通过一个涵盖20个生长季（2001/02-2020/21）的巴西大豆案例研究，采用留一年交叉验证方法，我们将MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer编码器和Mamba状态空间模型与线性岭回归以及五年移动平均的“农民”基线进行了基准比较。所有深度学习变体均优于岭回归，且所有序列编码器均超越了非序列的MLP。其中Transformer实现了最佳的国家级预测精度
tldr: 该研究提出了一种仅依赖常规天气数据和两个轻量级静态输入的节俭型深度学习框架，在巴西大豆20个生长季的国家级产量预测中，Transformer编码器取得了最佳预测精度，且所有深度学习模型均优于传统基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an input-frugal deep learning framework that uses only routine weather data plus two lightweight static inputs for national crop-yield forecasting, where the Transformer encoder achieves the best accuracy in a 20-season Brazilian soybean case study, with all deep learning models outperforming traditional baselines.
